FN-KXZZUAA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 93
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 02/05/2025
House Bill 93 as introduced would decrease the administrative obligations of the Office of the
Alabama State Auditor by a nominal amount by exempting the property of the Alabama State
Port Authority from the property audit provisions of the State Auditor.
Page 1

Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 02/18/2025
House Bill 93 as passed the House of Representatives would decrease the administrative
obligations of the Office of the Alabama State Auditor by a nominal amount by exempting the
property of the Alabama State Port Authority from the property audit provisions of the State
Auditor.
